spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_sheath_draw.de: Weapon Form (blade). A fast dash that cuts everything it passes on the draw; half again as hard on a foe that isn't after you.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_crescent_sweep: Weapon Form (blade). A low, wide arc in front that trips: foes are slowed and knocked off their feet.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_rain_of_cuts.d: Weapon Form (blade masterstroke). On a fallen foe, a flurry of cuts, the last one a heavy blow.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_wheel_cut.name: Wheel Cut
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_wheel_cut.desc: Weapon Form (blade). The blade circles overhead, then one heavy blow across a wide arc. No guard parries it and it beats a shield down. Costs feathers. Hold attack with a sword to start it.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_figure_eight.d: Weapon Form (blade). The blade spins in eights, cutting all round and turning aside what comes from the front, until your feathers give out. Press again to stop.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_hurled_blade.d: Weapon Form (blade). Throw the blade in your hand. It sticks where it lands.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_mill_charge.de: Weapon Form (staff or glaive). A short dash with the shaft turning before you: it strikes everyone you pass and turns what comes from ahead.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_spear_lunge.de: Weapon Form (spear). A long lunge that runs the first foe through and goes on into a second behind it.
Weapon Form (spear, mounted). Couch the lance: the first foe it meets is hit harder the faster your mount goes, and unhorsed.
Weapon Form (spear masterstroke). Throw the spear into a fallen foe and pin it where it lies. Tap the Combat Art key to tug it back.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_ground_stomp.d: Weapon Form (fist). A hop, and on landing a shockwave that hurts and throws up foes standing near.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_falling_fist.d: Weapon Form (fist). While falling, drive down: the first foe your fall meets takes part of its force.
Weapon Form (knife). Mark the foe you look at, seen through walls. Cast again while it's marked to dash behind it and stab.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_cast_off_cloak: Weapon Form (knife). Leave a straw figure where you stood for foes to swing at while you slip away.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_tangle_cord.de: Weapon Form (knife). Throw bolas from your pack that wrap the first foe's legs.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_rending_claw.d: Weapon Form (claw). A rake across the front that cuts every foe in the arc and leaves them bleeding.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_feral_pounce.d: Weapon Form (claw). Leap onto the foe ahead, knock it flat with a savage blow and a short bleed.
